notes.title: 1.1.2 - Leaderboards Update + Future Plans!
notes.content:
It's been a little longer than expected, but finally got the Leaderboard Update tested and ready for the upcoming Summer Steam Sale!



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45155863/e34e5af23f9144b94d5bfffac83cd8ceba9a055c.png"]

Go for the top time and top scores in your favourite levels or simply try and take on the Gauntlet to prove you're the best assassin out there!


Future Plans
I still plan on adding more to the game including a second gauntlet that's mostly finished, as well as a Temple Defence/Raid mode similar to something like Zombies mode from CoD with a few rogue-like elements thrown in as that's always a genre I've wanted to experiment with. 



Progress will be a little slower than before due to transitioning to full-time hours with other work, but there are still plans for this game and any support goes a long way in helping with more resources to speed up development!



Thanks for reading, and hope you enjoy! (P.S. if you have any feedback or want to follow the development, hop on down to our Discord)
